mapper.select: SELECT id, floor_plan_id, created_by, current_version_id, title, description, created_at FROM layouts WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM layouts WHERE id = #{layoutId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, name, image_url, width, height FROM floor_plans WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, layout_id, version, status, optimistic_lock, created_at FROM layout_versions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y FROM walls WHERE layout_version_id = #{layoutVersionId} ORDER BY id ASC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO floor_plans (name, image_url, width, height) VALUES (#{name}, #{imageUrl}, #{width}, #{height})
INSERT INTO layouts (floor_plan_id, created_by, title, description) VALUES (#{floorPlanId}, #{createdBy}, #{title}, #{description})
INSERT INTO layout_versions (layout_id, version, status, optimistic_lock) VALUES (#{layoutId}, #{version}, #{status}, #{optimisticLock})

INSERT INTO walls (layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y) VALUES
(#{wall.layoutVersionId}, #{wall.name}, #{wall.startX}, #{wall.startY}, #{wall.endX}, #{wall.endY})

INSERT INTO pillars (layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, rotation) VALUES
(#{pillar.layoutVersionId}, #{pillar.name}, #{pillar.startX}, #{pillar.startY}, #{pillar.endX}, #{pillar.endY}, #{pillar.rotation})

INSERT INTO fabrics (layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y, rotation) VALUES
(#{fabric.layoutVersionId}, #{fabric.name}, #{fabric.startX}, #{fabric.startY}, #{fabric.endX}, #{fabric.endY}, #{fabric.rotation})

INSERT INTO outside_walls (layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y) VALUES
(#{outsideWall.layoutVersionId}, #{outsideWall.name}, #{outsideWall.startX}, #{outsideWall.startY}, #{outsideWall.endX}, #{outsideWall.endY})

INSERT INTO layout_texts (layout_version_id, text, x, y) VALUES

INSERT INTO layout_exits (layout_version_id, name, start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y) VALUES
